QuestInfo.name: Hazard's Files
QuestInfo.0: Now that you and #bPopoh#k have found Mr. Hazard's old Hideout, it's time to start snooping around for some info.
QuestInfo.1: Beat up around #r30#k of Mr. Hazard's old crew and gather information. #rHazard's Rotten Cronies#k ought to know something.
QuestInfo.2: Well, if the grumblings of Hazard's cronies are true, then Mr. Hazard's pretty lazy when it comes to cleaning the hideout floor.

1.msg: This place is crawling with the leftovers of Hazard's gang. Might be they know something useful...\r\n
